reasoning: The tomato leaf shows numerous small (1-3mm), dark brown-black spots scattered across the entire leaf surface, several surrounded by yellow chlorotic halos, with marginal browning. This pattern — small, uniformly dark spots with halos broadly distributed on a green tomato leaf — is the classic presentation of Bacterial Speck caused by Pseudomonas syringae pv. tomato. Septoria was considered but lacks the typical lighter spot centers; Early Blight ruled out by absence of concentric rings.
